note: No fact: the document is a tender for network equipment (Wi-Fi, firewalls, cabling, UPS) at thirteen police sites, the enabling class. It names no system in which a station records a report or a case. The annex shows existing data points, server or communication rooms and cabling at the sites, to be cleaned up and extended, and lists charge offices, records and registry rooms as areas to be covered, with nothing on what is recorded there.
